subject: Taxes
title: State Income Tax Differences
description: Learn State Income Tax Differences in one minute.

hook.text: Seven US states charge zero income tax. California charges up to 13.3%.

buildup.text: Texas, Florida, Nevada, and four other states have no state income tax.

discovery.text: Remote work enabled 'tax migration.' Workers move to zero-tax states while keeping high-paying jobs in expensive cities.

twist.text: Zero-income-tax states often have higher sales or property taxes.

climax.text: State tax shopping is reshaping where Americans live and work. Geography is becoming a tax planning strategy.

punchline.text: Zero in Texas, 13.3% in California. Same job, different state, different bill.

quiz.question: How many US states have no state income tax?
